trends.name: Iran Escalation & Hormuz Strait Crisis
trends.summary: IRGC Navy issued retaliatory strikes targeting US-linked industrial assets in UAE and Bahrain, with explicit threats to expand operations and accelerate America's regional removal. Prediction markets show only 30% odds of Hormuz reopening before June 1, down sharply. U.S. deploying 82nd Airborne paratroopers to CENTCOM region for potential ground operations.

trends.name: Oil Price Spike & Energy Market Shock
trends.summary: U.S. oil prices surged 10% following Trump's Iran war speech, with BlackRock's Fink warning that $150 oil could trigger global recession. Record $977M poured into short oil ETF ($SCO) just before the rally, creating massive trader losses. Energy shock driving inflation concerns globally and mortgage rate increases.

trends.name: Stock Market Selloff & Risk-Off Sentiment
trends.summary: S&P 500 erased $830B at market open; down 1.25% with Nasdaq down 1.67% and Dow down 1.33%. S&P 500 on track for 10th consecutive red Thursday—longest losing streak in history. Options traders bracing for wild swings as family offices stall deal-making and investment appetite evaporates.

trends.name: Tech Sector Geopolitical Risk & Supply Chain
trends.summary: Iran's Revolutionary Guard threatened direct attacks on U.S. tech companies including Nvidia and Apple. Taiwan's TSMC exposure to Hormuz disruptions and potential conflict escalation poses significant supply chain risk for semiconductor production and AI infrastructure.

trends.name: Auto Sector Delivery Misses & Demand Weakness
trends.summary: Tesla Q1 deliveries of 358,023 units missed estimates of 372,160 (-3.8%), while Ford's Q1 deliveries fell 8.8% YoY to 457,315 units. Both misses signal softening consumer demand amid economic uncertainty and war premium in financing costs.

trends.name: Trump Tariffs & Pharmaceutical/Trade Policy
trends.summary: Trump administration preparing up to 100% tariffs on imported pharmaceuticals, adding to inflationary pressure. Combined with auto tariff risks and existing trade tensions, this signals broad protectionist policy that could inflate costs across healthcare and manufacturing sectors.

trends.name: Private Credit Redemption Crisis & Liquidity
trends.summary: Blue Owl capped private credit fund redemptions at 5% after steep request levels, signaling liquidity stress in the $2+ trillion private credit market. This redemption shock indicates investor panic and potential forced asset sales, threatening financial stability.

trends.name: Inflation Divergence: Energy vs. Services
trends.summary: Euro area inflation rising on energy shock while core trends remain limited. U.S. inflation moved sideways in 2025 as tariffs boosted goods prices while services inflation moderated. Oil and geopolitical shocks creating asymmetric inflation pressures that complicate Fed policy.

trends.name: Healthcare System Breakdown & Insurance Friction
trends.summary: Escalating doctor-patient-insurer conflicts as healthcare providers and patients fight insurance denials and coverage restrictions. This systemic friction threatens healthcare sector profitability and could trigger regulatory action or consolidation.

trends.name: Capital Expenditure Surge in Industrial Sector
trends.summary: Caterpillar ($CAT) aggressively expanding capex to $3.5B in 2026 (+25% YoY) to boost capacity amid construction and energy costs doubling. Industrial companies racing to secure capacity before escalating input costs lock in higher structural pricing.

trends.name: Mortgage Rates & Housing Affordability Crisis
trends.summary: Mortgage rates rising for fifth consecutive week following Iran war-driven bond selloff. Homebuyers facing sharply reduced purchasing power as rates climb, signaling potential housing market slowdown and consumer stress on affordability.

trends.name: Job Market Deterioration & Economic Slowdown
trends.summary: U.S. job creation slowing meaningfully; March jobs report expected to show continued weakness. Combined with mortgage rate spikes and oil-driven inflation, labor market softening signals recession risk acceleration.
